triage.note: D10 defect 4, postmortem shape S3. The three input modes each rendered `<button id="go-…">Extract</button>`: role `button`, accessible name "Extract", three times. Any plan targeting the button resolves to 3 matches — the ambiguity failure the browser-agent repo's M38 exists for. Watched red against the unmodified file: `#go-fx: no accessible name of its own — all three modes read "Extract", which is the 3-match ambiguity` and the same for `#go-up` and `#go-url`. Green once each carries a distinct aria-label (fixture / uploaded file / EDGAR URL). The check also fails on DUPLICATE labels, not just missing ones, so copy-pasting one aria-label onto all three does not satisfy it. The VISIBLE label stays "Extract" on all three deliberately — that is what the button does in every mode; the mode is what differs, and that is what the accessible name now says.

provenance: D10, created 2026-08-26 before the ARIA fix, per hard rule 2. Narrative: browser-agent repo docs/evals/2026-08-24-demo-sec10k-inspector-postmortem.md section 1 (S3) and section 3, remediation item 4.
